name: tastemaker
title_zh: 把参考图变成同风格 UI 的生成器
tagline_zh: 受够了千篇一律的 AI 蓝白界面？贴一张 Pinterest 或 Dribbble 图，它就能让落地页、仪表盘。
tagline_en: Tired of generic AI blue-and-white UI? Paste a Pinterest or Dribbble link, and it makes your landing page.
desc_en: Generate genuinely beautiful, on-brand UI instead of generic "AI slop" — use whenever the user asks to build, design, style, or improve a UI, landing page, dashboard, app screen, or component, whenever a PRD/spec needs a design pass before implementation, whenever the user pastes reference images/Pinterest/Dribbble links and wants the app to look like them, or whenever the user complains the AI-ge
why_zh: 它不靠提示词猜风格，而是直接解析参考图的视觉特征（配色、间距、字体、质感），再映射到目标界面。
why_en: It doesn't guess style from prompts—it parses the reference image's visual DNA (palette, spacing, type, texture) and maps it.
limit_zh: 只认静态参考图（PNG/JPG/链接），不解析视频或动效；产物是前端代码（HTML/CSS/React）。
limit_en: Only static images (PNG/JPG/links); no video/motion parsing. Output is front-end code (HTML/CSS/React), not design files. Highly abstract or chaotic.
